label: D1 after a reward, early in the episode, when the agent is about to choose a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and almost only when the reward input is 1 (98.8% of mass; D1 & in_rew==1 alone has recall 0.95 but precision 0.22). It mostly fires in the first ~50 trials of an episode (rate drops about 10x after trial 50), and it prefers steps where the upcoming GO choice is a2 (the policy logit leans a2; good=S2 also has lift 1.5x). action at D1 is the agent own upcoming choice, which it computes, so this is not a forbidden future variable; using the policy logit (choice < 0) instead gives a similar dev F1 (0.73 vs 0.75). The value head sits in a narrow band (7.54-7.73) on 71% of the mass. Never fires after an unrewarded trial, at GO or D2, or after a D1 fixation error. Incomplete: the top-quartile activations include many rewarded D1s before a1 choices in high_first episodes, which the a2 clause misses (top-quartile coverage is about 0.5), and many early rewarded a2 D1s stay silent.
